document: Make it unlawful for shops to refuse cash payments., Make it illegal for retailers and services to decline cash payments., Businesses small and large across the UK have discriminated on people that is cash to pay for goods. Not everyone wants a digital trail and others simply cannot pay by card.

Introduce additional bank holiday payments for state pensions, People in receipt of the state pension and who are no longer working receive no benefit for a bank holiday, unlike many employees. We want the Government to provide an extra day's payment to state pensions for each bank holiday, so that pensioners benefit from these public holidays.,

Make keeping birds in cages illegal, We believe it's far too normalised to keep a bird in a cage, often with other birds. I've seen birds in cages in various stores and it shouldn't be legal. It's not necessary to cage birds, just for the entertainment of humans.,
Stop tax payer's money being used to support migration., Stop using British tax payer's money to support migration., Use the money to prevent migration and secure boarders.

Increase the basic state pensions by £500 a year as an emergency measure, Both old and new state pensions to be increased by £500 pa as an emergency measure to compensate for the suspension of the triple lock and to help pensioners cope with the cost-of-living crisis, including increases in energy and food prices. The payment to be consolidated into future pension rates., The suspension of the triple lock was agreed by Parliament before the full impact of the energy crisis on prices was known. Silver Voices estimates that the 3.1% increase in pensions due in April will be about half the prevailing rate of inflation then. A lump sum increase of £500 pa would cover the losses to pensioners caused by the triple lock suspension and help ensure millions of older people don't have to choose between eating and heating this winter.

Keep Lateral Flow Tests free for everyone, Government sources have leaked Boris Johnson’s plan to stop Lateral Flow Tests from being free. These plans must be addressed formally by the government and scrapped., Lateral flow tests have been an essential way to test before attending events, visiting vulnerable friends/family and also for work. By making them no longer free, this reduces the accessibility for the British public who are already facing an increase in national insurance, energy prices and more. Cases are still rapidly increasing and with COVID-19 mutating, this couldn’t come at a more inconvenient time.

Give help and  support for people  with their energy bills, People are going to endure 51% increase in their energy bills from April 2022, they are going to have to either eat or Heat, It's disgraceful that members of parliament and government employees etc  so the daily mail online alleges that MPs are claiming thousands of pounds in energy expenses for 2nd homes while claiming they could not help people on legacy benefits, people  with covid expenses people on low-income snd the most vulnerable in society 

Its seems the government are more focused on living s high-class lifestyle than looking after the most vulnerable in society .
Stop the propsed ammendments to the bill of rights, Stop the Humen right of speech to be taken away and uphold the law, Uphold the  law and not commit harm to the people

Call for general election following government parties during lockdowns, I call on a national general election to have a say in who runs this country. This is gollowing all the revelations of parties in various government buildings during regional and national lockdowns., This is not about any ongoing investigations but a call for a full public say in to who should lead the country rather than the standing government. My lack of confidence is due to the perception of "one rule does not fit all" following parties alongside the perception of "cronyism". A public vote is the only acceptable way forward.

Reinstate the pensioners triple lock.
They cannot cope with the price rises., Inflation is heading for 7% and pensioners cannot cope with this year's price rises.
We are the fifth largest economy and have the lowest pensions in Europe!, Help the pensioners to level up!

Stop anyone in government claiming for unnecessary expenses, Stop the PM, MPs, Mayor's, Councillors and anyone else in government from claiming unnecessary expenses for the likes of household bill, second homes, food, fines, travel. The working people of this country are taxed upon taxed and are struggling to stay a float and can not claim for these things., The people of this country put the money into the pot through all the taxes they have to pay and can not claim anything back for these expenses. The people deserve to have their money they put into the pot spent in better ways. The political parties in this country get paid wages for doing their job, a lot have 2nd incomes also or interest by themselves or family members to other financial gains. 
This claiming expenses needs to STOP!

Increase funding for treatment of chronic back pain and sciatica., I would like the govement to fund the NHS to support and treat people who suffer chronic pain and sciatica much quicker, So many individuals are suffering due to chronic back pain and sciatica pain caused by either spinal cysts, bulging discs etc. The pain these individuals suffer can only be described as excruciating. The pain is that bad they find themselves depressed, been unable to work and claiming benefits, and in some extreme cases taking their own lives. All this has a massive impact on the NHS aswell as DWP . Due to been left by the NHS for so long even before covid I and others have injured and caused damage to other parts of their body by the way they have had to try walk or sometimes crawl to get about. This is unnecessary additional costs on the NHS that does not need to happen and something needs to change

Instruct DWP to stop referring to State Retirement Pension as a Benefit!, Any reference to State Pension to be called exactly that!  
Nowhere should the State Pension be called a BENEFIT!, The State Pension is paid as a result of workers paying in to the pension scheme all through their working life.  Benefits are payments given to people in need for a whole variety of reasons!  
State Pension is NOT a Benefit!

Move the state pension age back to 60 for men and women, The Government should move the state pension age back to 60 for men and women. People should not have to wait until their mid to late 60s to claim the state pension., Many people have worked from a young age, and their health deteriorates long before they are able to claim the state pension. The Government should not be able to move the state pension back when people have had a reasonable expectation of retiring at 60.

Do not increase state pension age above 66, The State Pension age is set to increase from 66 to 68 over the coming years, and there are concerns this could be further increased in the future. We want the Government to halt future increases and leave the State Pension age where it currently stands for both Men and Women., The decision made was based on the Cridland review of the State Pension, on the basis of increased life expectancies. However, increases in life expectancy have stalled in recent years, and we believe it is therefore not fair to increase State Pension Age above 66.
 
State Pension age increase proposals: https://www.gov.uk/government/news/proposed-new-timetable-for-state-pension-age-increases
 
ONS data on life expectancies in the UK: https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/birthsdeathsandmarriages/lifeexpectancies/bulletins/nationallifetablesunitedkingdom/2018to2020

Commission NICE to Review Guidelines on Chronic Pain (Published April 2021), Around 15.5 million people suffer from Chronic Pain (Verus Arthrtis, 2021). A number of commonly used and vital treatments for pain relief and management are no longer recommended, and we believe the new guidelines do not meet the needs of people suffering from chronic pain., Experts on pain have said that taking painkillers away from those in desperate need is a cruel health policy: https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2021/apr/09/painkillers-cruel-health-policy-nice-guidelines
 
The review should consider evidence and statements provided by relevant stakeholders, organisations and campaign groups.
 
Experts have argued that because chronic pain has such an important impact on the lives of people who live with it, that every tool available is needed to help in its management.

Stop referring to the UK State Retirement Pension as a 'Benefit', We demand that the State Retirement Pension be referred to as State Pension Entitlement and for any use of the word 'Benefit' to be deleted from the Pension system!, The word' benefit' is objectional to generations of hard working people who have paid into the NI System as contribution towards their pension 
We need the word 'benefit' to be removed from any reference to the State Retirement Pension. 
The Pension is an 'Entitlement' ...it is not a 'Beneift'  
For it to be a 'benefit' it would be payable to men and women at equal amounts.
Please don't dismiss this petition under the pretext you used previously that 'you didn't make clear what you wanted the Government to do!'
Stop using the word 'Benefit' when referring to the the State Retirement Pension

Change the Standard Method for calculating local housing need, We call on the Government to change the standard method for calculating local housing need. The current method uses growth projections from 2014, which we believe is out of date and more recent data should be used to calculate the baseline amount of housing needed. , We also believe that there should be no “affordability” uplift applied in large areas of greenbelt, AONB, National Parks or areas within 5.6km of Special Areas of Conservation (SACs). Because the uplift increases the ‘true need’ figure by up to 40% it does not address affordability, and in addition, building too many homes in these areas could have negative environmental effects.

Reduce MP remunerations by one half., Government should reduce the remuneration of Members of Parliament by one half and retrospectively from taking office after the last General Election., They do not deserve to avoid the financial pain and losses being inflicted upon those who voted and finance them.

Stop changing the clocks - Keep British Summer Time all year, It is pointless and impractical to change the clocks every spring and autumn. We want the Government to keep the UK on British Summer Time (BST) - also known as Daylight Saving Time - all year.,

Stop the privatisation of Channel 4, The Government have announced they intend to push ahead with the privatisation of Channel 4, and this will be included in May’s Queen’s Speech.

This plan must be abandoned and Channel 4 kept in public hands., By becoming privatised this risks commercial decisions determining what is commissioned. 

Channel 4 currently has the freedom to produce shows that are culturally balanced, hard hitting and informative - programmes that may not be commercially successful with the advertisers but important to produce nonetheless.

Privatising the channel risks subjecting it to the whims of advertisers - producing shows based on if they can make a profit rather than doing it for an informative purpose.

Stop Privatisation of C4, Channel 4 should remain publicly funded and continue to work to its mandate, Channel 4 provides a wide variety of  programmes not found on other channels due to its mandate, these programmes are at risk if not mandated. C4 also provides a large free streaming service which is at risk if the channel is sold to profit making enterprise.

Ban hedge cutting and non-essential tree felling between March and August, All hedgerow cutting or trimming and non-essential tree felling should be banned between March and August to give declining bird species a chance to breed undisturbed by human activity., According to Defra figures, farmland birds have declined by 57% and woodland birds by 27% between 1970 and 2018. RSPB research shows 16 out of 20 garden birds are in decline. 

Each spring, many people enter their gardens and decide a hedgerow needs cutting back or a shade-causing tree needs felling. Unfortunately, large swathes of the public are unaware that this activity is detrimental to birds. Neither the public nor tree surgeons should be cutting hedges or trees from March to August.

Cancel the sale of Channel 4, Cancel the planned sale/privatisation of Channel 4, Channel 4 cost the taxpayer nothing.  In public ownership it has thrived.  The management and most of the respondents to the consultation are opposed to this action.

Stop the Privatisation of Channel Four, Channel Four is no burden to British tax payers. It raises funds from advertising and ploughs profit into independent production companies supporting the UK creative industry and UK jobs., Please protect Channel Four’s not for profit status  and stop its privatisation. If the government refuses to stop the privatisation please explain how private owners will safeguard, or increase, current levels of investment into the UK creative film and media industry. Please explain plans to safeguard UK jobs.  Please also explain how the channel’s impartial and high quality of journalism be safeguarded and protected from private interest.

Stop the privatisation of Channel 4, Plans to privatise Channel 4 should be dropped and it should be left with its current ownership and funding model., Privatising Channel 4 would seriously damage the channel, which has commissioned much high quality television since its inception. Privatising it would lead to a push for profit and a consequent drop in standards, and possibly to foreign ownership of the channel.

Address the persecution and displacement of the stateless Kuwaiti Bidoon people, We want the Parliament to listen to the indigenous stateless Kuwaiti Bidoon people and call on the Government of the United Kingdom to take a decisive part in advocating an urgent, fair and conclusive solution to the Bidoon’s problem in liaison with the Kuwaiti diplomatic and political leadership., The UK bears a moral responsibility to the Bidoon's plight. Britain developed Kuwait’s administrative systems when it was a protectorate. Sir Richard Beaumont attested (Registry No. BA 1017/26) the Kuwaiti Nationality Law would create a deprived people "in what is and has always been their home”. However, the British Government then did not intervene, and it allowed an incompetent, less transparent elite to deprive the Bidoon from their right to belong to their homeland to take place.

Increase the basic State Pension to align with the new State Pension, The Government should increase the basic State Pension to match the new State Pension. I don’t think it’s very fair to have a two tier system, especially when it increases in percentage terms and so gets even further apart., The older pensioners have paid in more over their lifetime and have never taken anything out of the system as this option was not available then. This could also cut down on administration staff by no longer having to do means testing.

Also many older people don’t have much in the way of savings as the wages were low and no employer-pension schemes were available.

Ban the sale and use of Rodenticides, I would like the Government to ban the sale and use of rodenticides. There is evidence of secondary poisoning of other species from the consumption of the target species that has ingested the rodenticide., Rodenticides are causing the deaths of other species of birds and mammals, caused by the consumption of prey which has ingested a rodenticide. Toxins from the chemical brodifacoum for example build up causing a slow, suffering death. The use of rodenticides is not target specific enough and can cause wider lethal implications to other animals in the environment. We believe the sale and use of these products should be banned.

Adopt British Double Summer Time, and British Standard Time in winter, This will help ordinary working people reduce their energy bills as it provides for longer useable daylight hours in the evening.

Historically British Double Summer Time has been implemented when there has been a need to conserve energy such as during WW2 and in 1973., People are struggling with their energy bills.

By implementing this change to time we will have more natural light in the evenings and this will help to reduce energy costs as well as afford more opportunity for exercise and improvement in mental health.
Ban the sale of anything rawhide for Dogs, Ban the sale and creation of anything rawhide for Dogs, Becasue rawhide is so dangerous and deadly for dogs and can kill

Stop the ban on tethering birds of prey, Stop defra's proposed ban on tethering birds or have birds of prey except from the new rules., If the ban on tethering birds of prey is allowed it will affect training birds of prey especially goshawks and Eagles and
lead to 85% -100% of all falconry centres in Britain especially those in the North to close down plus the practice of tethering birds of prey as part of there training and management has be done since the beaker period and on that basis falconry and austringer should be protected under unesco as part of our cultural heritage.

Stop paying Northern Irish politicians refusing to form our government., The members of stormont are refusing to form our government but are still being fully paid. Suspend all pay and expenses without chance of back pay., Anyone who refuses to work does not get their full pay. It is unfair that the main parties will not be working but getting paid by the tax payer. We had it for 3 years and refuse to accept it again.

Implement a policy whereby pensioners receive free dental treatment, All pensioners should be eligible for FREE dental treatment., I have had 6 years of my expected state pension taken away by the government, as have thousands of others, and during the last 10 years have not visited a dentist as I cannot afford to!

Put a price cap on all dog breeds so we can stop theft and puppy farmers, Please put a price cap in all dog breeds .
Pet theft and farming and unlicensed breeders are causing misery and pain in the united kingdom .

Violence is extreme now to get our dogs from us ., Please put a price cap in all dog breeds .
Pet theft and farming and unlicensed breeders are causing misery and pain in the united kingdom .

Allow Driving theory test to expire three years instead of two, Because of the long delays caused by Covid, it is taking up to 6 months to get a driving test which only allows 3 tests before having to resit theory test again.  Pre pandemic, it was possible to attempt test every 3 months.  Until tests are back to this level, extend the Theory test to 3 years, It seems unfair that people are not being given the same opportunity to obtain their driving test and licence as those pre pandemic.  The backlog of people waiting for both Theory and Practical tests is so long now.  As people get older it maybe takes more time to learn the required driving standards and the space between the number of practical tests that can be taken has been reduced, due to the back log.  A one year extension on the Theory Test would help avoid this discriminatory anomaly

Hold an inquiry into Downing St event on 13 November 2020, Sue Gray conceded in her report that the alleged party in the Downing Street flat during the lockdown on 13th November 2020 has not been investigated by her or the police.

This is totally unacceptable and unfair on those who have been fined and held to account for lockdown breaches., To ensure accountability and standards in public office, it is paramount that the alleged flat party is investigated. The public deserve to know the truth.

Cancel the energy bill rebate for second homes, I feel it is a very poor use of public money, when there are many more people urgently in need of support. The Government should amend this scheme so people are only eligible for a rebate for their main home.,

Increase State pensions to £380 a week, and lower retirement age to 60, The British State pension is far too low. We want the Government to increase the basic state pension to £19,760 a year (£380 a week), and extend this to anyone aged 60 or over. This should lift thousands out of poverty, and give our elderly folk more spending power and help grow the economy., The Government should restore the state pension age back to 60 for men and women, because, people should not have to wait until their mid to late 60's to claim the state pension, as many people have worked from a young age, and their health deteriorates long before they are able to claim the state pension.

Provide additional funding for swimming pools due to the energy increases, The Government MUST give additional funding to local authorities to ensure swimming pools facing reduced hours or closure due to the current and looming energy increases are able to stay open. Pools require additional energy to keep the pools warm and safe to swim in., Swimming is an essential life skill, and many schools and home education communities rely on local pools to provide lessons to our children. In addition swimming provides essential health benefits for many people who suffer with chronic pain and restrictive disabilities. Not to mention the health benefits and general well-being that swimming provides to the whole population. Swimming pools MUST remain open and available.

Make it illegal to refuse to employ or dismiss a person based on their tattoos, Make it so that employers can't fire existing employees or refuse to hire future ones because of a tattoo. The only legal exception to the rule should be if the tattoo depicts or endorses inappropriate or discriminatory behavior., I want the Government or Parliament to do this because the aesthetic of an individual person and what they choose to do with their body should not have an effect on their employment if they are perfectly capable of the job they have or have applied for. In a situation where a tattoo is discriminatory towards others or openly suggests violent or discriminatory acts towards others, then I believe it is justified for an employer to refuse work for an individual,that should be the only exception.

Introduce end-of-life payments for people who die before receiving state pension, If a person has paid National Insurance for years (eg. 20, 30, 40 years) and they die before receiving a state pension, the Government should make an end-of-life payment to the person's estate. This could help cover bills or funeral costs, or go to people in the deceased's will., As the age to receive your state pension has been increased significantly over the past several years, it is a fact that more people will die before they reach their state pension age.
 
For people who have worked hard and contributed, and unfortunately die before receiving their state pension, we believe it is fair that their estate or should be awarded an end-of-life payment, This could help cover any outstanding bills or funeral costs, or go to beneficiaries of the deceased's estate. Payments could be along the lines of: 20 yrs £5000, 30 yrs £7500, 40 yrs or more £10,000.

Require all government agencies and schools to accept cash, It is increasingly hard to use cash to pay for government services. This is alienating too many in society - it feels like discrimination, and should stop. Children need to learn to use cash yet most schools will not accept it, often under the guise of safety. Cash is imperative for a free society., I want the Government to support our freedoms and not overreach. It feels like there is a lot of inadvertent discrimination against a certain proportion of society. There are lots of people without smartphones that are being ostracised from society, this is not acceptable. Cash is legal tender so why should our Government bodies be allowed to refuse it?

Create a regulator for courier companies and impose stricter penalties, The Government should create a regulator for courier companies with the power to:, - investigate customer service and any allegations of criminality such as the theft of parcels; and

- impose tough penalties breaching these new regulations, up to companies being forcefully shut down.

This regulator would then refer cases of criminality to the police. Too many people’s belongings are being damaged or lost. People who are unwilling or unable to go through the courts process are losing money to companies worth millions of pounds who don’t face strong enough penalties to incentivise better service.

Cancel the 2022 House of Commons summer recess, The country is in a mess, yet the House of Commons is closing down and won't be sitting from 22nd July to 5th September. This year the summer recess should be cancelled and MPs work in Parliament through the summer to address the multiple serious issues facing the country., No other business or organisation would condone closing down for the summer with so much serious business to attend to. Why should the House of Commons be any different?

Pay student teachers for their placement and provide bursaries for training, Trainee teachers should be provided with a grant to aid their studies and pay for their travel to placement. Being paid for their hours worked on placement would ensure all students have a fair chance at succeeding at teacher training., Student teachers cannot work enough hours to live alongside full time placement, therefore they should receive payment for hours worked on placement and/ or a grant to aid their travel to placement. The number of student teachers is falling dramatically due to lack of funding to study and this needs to change.

Allow culling of black-backed gulls using a general licence, In 2020 black-backed gulls were removed from the list of birds that can be killed using a general licence, which allows an authorised person to kill or take certain animals to prevent serious damage to livestock, crops, vegetables, fruit, fisheries or inland waters. We want this decision reversed., Black-backed gulls can spread diseases to livestock, and kill smaller birds, and a particular issues in parts of the country.
 
We want the Government to add black-backed gulls back to the list of animals that can be killed or taken using a general licence, so populations can be controlled.
Cancel HS2, The construction of HS2 is destroying green land and homes, and will benefit only a small proportion of people. We want the Government to cancel this scheme immediately.,

Remove legal protections for the Herring Gull, It's a criminal offence to cause harm to wild birds, including the Herring Gull, without a licence. Licenses are difficult to obtain. Legal protections for Herring Gulls should be removed to make it easier for councils and householders to deal with these birds, for example removing nests from roofs., Herring Gulls now nest widely in urban areas. These birds are extremely noisy, damage property, and cause palpable distress to many, both adults and children, stealing food from their hands, frightening the latter especially and causing many people to avoid eating outdoors. Herring Gulls are large and can be aggressive, especially in breeding season, They confer few benefits on the world at large or humankind specifically. Legal protections for Herring Gulls should be removed.

Take action to prevent illegal attempts to enter UK across the Channel, The Government must take further action to stop illegal attempts to enter the UK across the Channel., People entering the UK illegally across the Channel are undocumented, and we do not know whether they pose a risk to the country. People entering the country this way also put additional pressure on already overstretched health and public services.

Deliver an emergency budget to deal with the cost of living crisis, The Government is being urged to act by the public, but does not appear to be doing anything to mitigate the impending crisis that millions are facing. An emergency budget must take place as soon as practicable to offer real support to those who are facing wipeout in the autumn and winter., The Government has the power to introduce a comprehensive support package that can be delivered in time before the utterly scandalous increase in energy prices takes place in the autumn. Whilst this Government's days are numbered, they are paid and elected by us to serve the best interests of the British people, and sitting idly by whilst other countries take appropriate measures is utterly negligent and dangerous.

Debate in Parliament loss of GMP indexation paid by DWP., I want the law changed so that people who reached state pension age on and after 6 April 2016 have the indexation paid on their guaranteed minimum pension (GMP)which is part of their occupational pension paid by the DWP., I want the GMP indexation paid as their are about 11 million people affected and that the possible loss can be up to about £25,000 if inflation was 5%.

Limit the school week to three days, We want the Government to shorten the school week to three days, from the current five., Given the current cost of living crisis, and high levels of inflation, we believe it would be better for schools to focus on delivering high-quality education for a three-day week, rather than struggling with the cost of continuing to remain open five days a week. This should reduce energy costs for schools, and travel costs for teachers.

Require all businesses and public services to accept cash payments, All businesses (excepting internet-based ones) and public services in which monetary transactions take place should be required by law to accept cash as a method of payment, As many businesses and taxpayer-funded public services are increasingly insisting upon cashless payments, it is important that we safeguard against the potential dangers of this practice. It creates an enforced dependency on banks, even though they cannot always be trusted to act ethically, and is a threat to privacy as people cannot make anonymous payments. If we wish to uphold freedom of choice and the right to privacy, it is imperative that we protect the use of cash.

Pay ALL social care workers the covid bonus, Pay every single social care worker who worked during lockdown the same bonus in every Borough, Many councils have not paid the bonus.  Liverpool,  for example.  The bonus should not depend on where you work

Launch an inquiry to identify the long-term solutions to current energy crisis, The Government needs to hold an inquiry to address the current energy crisis, and to identify a long-term solution that works in favour or the people., It needs to be addressed at the root cause rather than using temporary measures that provide limited respite from the massive increases in price.
 
Many people will be left without food and warmth if the current crisis is not addressed urgently. Most of the nation are worried about how they are going to manage to afford the significant increase on their bills. People should not be worrying about these extortionate prices. We have already seen significant increases during the summer months. The further increases will inevitably have a knock on effect on all products in the supply chain as we've already seen.

Require schools to have cubicles in student changing rooms

 , We believe schools should be required to have cubicles in student changing rooms, so students can change in privacy. In many schools students have no choice but to change in front of classmates., It is not okay that children are often expected to change in front of their classmates. All students should be able to change in private, in a cubicle, when getting changed at school.

Some children use their phones in changing rooms, and could be taking photos or videos of other children getting changed. Requiring schools to have cubicles in changing rooms should help protect the privacy of children.

Restore guaranteed minimum pension (GMP) indexation of the state pension, I want the Government to change the law to reinstate uprating of state pensions in respect of contracted out occupational pensions known as Guaranteed Minimum Pensions (GMP)., I believe it is not fair that the DWP ceased to uprate state pensions in respect of certain pension entitlements when the new state pension was introduced. I believe this with done without adequate consultation or notice, and should be reversed

Stop pensioners paying Income Tax on private pensions, We were encouraged to take out Private pensions to help in later life. Any increase in State Pension, is taken back by Tax on Private Pension.
, as tax was already paid on wages at source., This would help Pensioners with the cost of living. As the energy costs rise along with inflation.

Scrap the mini-budget and ensure independent review of any replacement package, The mini budget hands the very richest people in society tax cuts equating to more than many considered key workers during the pandemic earn in a year. Meanwhile, banker bonus caps introduced following reckless financier activity will be removed. There is no ethical or moral basis for either move., This is not an 'all in it together' mini budget and notably was termed a mini budget to avoid independent review by the Office for Budget Responsibility (OBR). Both of the above highlighted moves are perverse with financial commentators and market reaction casting doubt on the budget's overall efficacy and long-term impact. It needs to be scrapped, these measures need to be removed and any replacement package should be reviewed thoroughly by the OBR to ensure soundness and fairness for all.

Recall the budget and abandon the mini budget, We want the government to abandon the mini budget and re-install confidence in the market., Home owners and tax payers shouldn’t be forced to pay for energy companies profits and bankers bonuses.

Millions have already been driven into poverty and now more hard working home owners are paying for the ideology of two members of parliament who have ignored the advice of experts far and wide.

Close All Abattoirs & Campaign for People to Go Vegan for World Vegan Day, 1.2 billion animals are slaughtered each year in the UK. In addition, almost one billion fish and 4.4 billion shellfish are killed each year in the UK. Requiring abattoirs to close and encouraging everyone to go vegan, even just for one day, may not save them all, but it could at least save some., Having been introduced to veganism and the facts about the horrific slaughter of animals for meat and other animal products, some people could decide to go vegan for life, or at least the foreseeable future.
 
Closing down all the abattoirs in this country even just for one day could give thousands/millions of animals a reprieve.
 
I also urge the UK Government to take advantage of this day (1st November) to encourage people to go vegan for life!

I want a review of the Pensions Process, I want a review of the Pensions system and fair play put in place for the thousands of British workers being ripped off., I want the DWP to address the unfairness of the Pensions in the UK. You are penalised for working all your life

Urgently review the pensions tax for public sector workers., The current pension tax is completely disincentivising frontline NHS staff, forcing them into early retirement or part time working. With Inflation the workforce will see massive tax bills and will be unable to pay these., This pension tax is completely counterproductive and I believe reviewing this will incentivise many frontline NHS staff to work more, not less.

Extend student finance to non-UK citizens habitually resident in the UK, There are many non-UK citizens living and working in the UK who would like to further their education but are hindered by a lack of access to student finance.
 
We want the Government to extend eligibility for student finance to non-UK citizens who are habitually resident in the UK., Many non-UK citizens have rights to live, work and even claim benefits, but most cannot access student finance to pursue higher education.
 
Extending student finance to this group would help promote higher education and make it easier for non-UK citizens living in the UK to pursue further education, including courses supporting professions where the UK has skills shortages.

Form an emergency coalition Government, We call on the Government and Parliament to form an emergency Government made up of MPs representing all political parties, and MPs who are independent. , In order for the UK to have the best possible chance of recovering from its current state, we believe an emergency coalition Government should be put in place.

We believe that the economy is broken, with high inflation and people struggling to make ends meet. We believe that the approach to immigration and the management of the NHS would be better dealt with if all MPs worked together in a coalition instead of behaving like school children.

Allow elderly parents of UK residents to live in the UK with private medical, Allow elderly parents of UK tax payers to live in the UK on a family visa, with the condition of them using private medical and not having access to the NHS. Currently parents of UK residents can only access family visas in limited circumstances., There are many UK residents who contribute a lot of money to the economy, yet sometimes feel unable to stay in the UK, as their elderly parents are ineligible to live in the UK with them. This can cause a loss in tax income for the UK.
 
Allowing elderly parents of UK residents to live in the UK would help incentivize them to stay, and if this is done with a restriction where they have to pay for private healthcare, this wouldn't add pressure to the NHS.

Keep triple lock on pensions, That the Government stick to what they said last year after freezing it that the Triple lock would be put back in place to be paid out in April 2023., Because the Government said and promised that triple lock would be put back. This is not a benefit this is the rights of all pensioners who have paid into system for years.
